quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #10
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: What does a red painted curb mean?

options.text: You can pick up or drop off passengers here.

questions.explanation: You cannot stop, stand, or park at a red curb.

questions.question: What commonly causes traffic accidents?

options.text: Driving too fast for the conditions

questions.explanation: Speeding causes many crashes. Not paying attention can cause you to hit other vehicles. Most rear-end collisions happen because drivers follow too closely.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Lanes move in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Lanes move in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
Lanes move in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Lanes move in the same direction. You can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lanes move in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean you cannot pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: Which must you obey over the other three?
questions.explanation: A police officer's directions take priority over signs, signals, and road markings.

questions.question: If you stop along the road at night, what should you do?

options.text: Turn on your emergency flashers and low beam headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your emergency flashers and low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Turn on your emergency flashers and low beams so other drivers can see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?

options.text: Do not speed on wet roads.
Keep your tires properly filled with air.

questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when tires slide on water. Low tire pressure and worn tread increase hydroplaning risk. Speeding also increases the risk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When driving behind another vehicle at night, what should you do?

options.text: Use high beam headlights until you are 10 feet away.

questions.explanation: Use high beams only in rural areas when no other cars are near. Switch to low beams when following another vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes will merge into one lane.

questions.question: Interstate driving requires drivers to:

options.text: Be able to drive safely at higher speeds.

questions.explanation: Safe interstate driving requires you to stay alert and be able to drive at high speeds.

questions.question: Your tire blows out while driving. You should:

options.text: Hold the steering wheel firmly and slow down gradually.
Turn on emergency flashers and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly and slow down gradually.
questions.explanation: Do not brake hard when a tire blows out. Grip the steering wheel tightly and stay in your lane. Slow down gradually by taking your foot off the gas. Once you are going slowly, apply the brakes lightly and move to a safe area.

questions.question: When driving near large trucks, you must allow for:

options.text: The longer distance trucks need to stop.
The shorter distance trucks need to stop.
The lower noise from large trucks.
The higher speed of large trucks.

questions.correctAnswerText: The longer distance trucks need to stop.
questions.explanation: Large trucks need more space to stop than smaller vehicles. Stay where the truck driver can see you. Don't park where the truck blocks your view of traffic.

questions.question: When merging onto the freeway, drive at:

options.text: The same speed as freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same speed as freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Merge onto the freeway at the same speed as traffic, unless the traffic is going over the speed limit.

questions.question: In New York, a blood alcohol content (BAC) of ____ proves intoxication.
questions.explanation: In New York State, a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher proves intoxication. A BAC of 0.05 percent or higher shows impairment.

questions.question: Which action blocks traffic flow?

options.text: Slowing down to look at a crash.
Using public transportation instead of driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slowing down to look at a crash.
questions.explanation: Slowing down to look at crashes (rubbernecking) causes traffic jams and should be avoided.

questions.question: You must show proof of insurance to police:

options.text: After a crash or when stopped for a ticket.
Only when stopped for a ticket.

questions.correctAnswerText: After a crash or when stopped for a ticket.
questions.explanation: Always carry proof of insurance while driving. Show your insurance and license to police when asked after a traffic stop or crash.

questions.question: When pulling into traffic from a parked spot, you should:

options.text: Drive slower than other traffic for 200 feet.
Wait for a gap large enough to reach the speed of traffic.
Wait for two vehicles to pass, then drive into the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a gap large enough to reach the speed of traffic.
questions.explanation: Wait for a safe gap in traffic that lets you speed up to match other vehicles before entering.

questions.question: When turning right on a green light, you must:

options.text: Stop and look for police cars.

questions.explanation: You can turn right or left at a green light unless a sign says you can't. When turning, let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection go first.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.
